desc: Establish that strong connectivity is equivalent to every internal cut having an added edge directed from the right side to the left side.
Formulate the sweep DP whose state counts unmatched black vertices crossing the current cut.
Derive the first-return excursion recurrence and its CDQ/NTT acceleration.
Correct the recurrence implementation so the artificial \(k=0\) boundary term is excluded.
Validate the corrected implementation on all provided samples and relevant edge cases.
Produce the final Python stdin/stdout solution.
